descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S08 No transcripts yet: no invented entry, no error, in both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U13 A patient with no transcripts yet shows a clear state with no error, no blank screen and no invented entry. (UAT Empty & Failure States ('Patient with no notes yet'); UAT 3.4)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both. (UAT 3.3; TFA-92594 AC 2)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Standard fixture: {hospitalPatient} and {snfResident} with no recording, no encounter notes and no history

When Open each chart's Encounter tab

Then The chart renders with no transcript row, no '0 lines' row, no error banner and no blank screen

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: each checkpoint mustContain the patient name; mustNotContain 'Most Recent', '(prior)', 'Earlier sessions', '0 lines', '· encounter notes', '· visit notes', 'Something went wrong' (U13). A hidden section versus an empty message is Q7 and is not judged

Where it ran: dev unit U25; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S08

No transcripts yet: no invented entry, no error, in both modes

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U25.verdict.json), unit U25 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 97 turns, 262 s, $0.77.

Plan: unit U25 (#25, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Chart tabs of a patient with no notes. Same legacy seed, same chart tabs. EFS S02 and TC-16 S08 both check the 'patient with no notes yet' state (TC-16 S08 cites UAT EFS state 2) on the same Encounter tab, with different checks, so they share the setup instead of being duplicates. TC-01 S09 only moves between the same tabs. Runs together with EFS/S02, TC-01/S09.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #25, U25; checked: yes): Pass — empty states on all three tabs, both modes, no error/invented content. Explains the U29 observation: Post-Round always shows a disabled 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button when there is no note — not stuck, but the wording reads as 'in progress' (UX copy, needs a human; EFS 'tell the physician what to do next')
